title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 9
subtitle: Pets Are Family, Too!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 9: Pets Are Family, Too! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Hey, Anna! How was your weekend?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜！周末过得怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It was great! I went to the D.C. State Fair.
dialogue.zh: 很棒！我去了华盛顿特区集市。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I would have gone, but I was busy. How was it?
dialogue.zh: 我本来想去，可是太忙了。怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It was awesome! I won first place in a pet contest!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我在宠物比赛里得了第一名！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: But, you don’t have a pet, do you?
dialogue.zh: 可是，你没有宠物，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes and no. What do you mean by “pet”?
dialogue.zh: 又有又没有。你说的“宠物”是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: A pet is an animal that lives with you. People love their pets. Ashley said, "You don’t have a pet, do you?" She used a tag question, a small question at the end of a sentence. Let's look for more of them!
dialogue.zh: 宠物是和你住在一起的动物。人们很爱自己的宠物。阿什莉说：“You don’t have a pet, do you?” 她用了反意疑问句，就是句子末尾的小问句。我们再找更多！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Look, a pet! Who’s this cute little dog?
dialogue.zh: 看，一只宠物！这只可爱的小狗是谁？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Oh, right. You haven’t met my dog, have you? This is Dublin.
dialogue.zh: 对哦。你还没见过我的狗，对吧？这是都柏林。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Dublin! Nice to meet you. He’s so cute!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，都柏林！很高兴认识你。它好可爱！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Thanks! So, tell me about the state fair.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！那跟我说说集市吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, there were the usual things -- fair food, cute babies, music. But there must have been a dozen different contests! And some were pretty strange.
dialogue.zh: 哦，都是些常见的东西——集市小吃、可爱的宝宝、音乐。可比赛大概有十来种！有的还挺奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There was a contest to see who could spit a watermelon seed the farthest. You should have seen all the people who wanted to spit a watermelon seed! And, it was pretty fun to watch. But Ashley, the pet contests were the best. There was a pet parade. Lots of people walked with their dogs.
dialogue.zh: 有一项比赛看谁能把西瓜籽吐得最远。你真该看看那么多人想吐西瓜籽！看起来也挺好玩。可阿什莉，宠物比赛才是最棒的。有宠物游行。很多人牵着狗走。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: That sounds so fun. But Anna, tell me, how did you win a pet contest without a pet?
dialogue.zh: 听起来好好玩。可安娜，告诉我，你没有宠物怎么赢了宠物比赛？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, the closest thing I have is my pet rock.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我最接近宠物的东西是我的宠物石头。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know it’s silly, but I’ve had it since I was a little girl. So, for a joke, I brought it to the fair. But then I was invited to enter the “One-of-Kind Pet” contest. And I won! (holds up first place ribbon)
dialogue.zh: 我知道这很傻，可我从小就有它。所以我开玩笑把它带到集市。后来我被邀请参加“独一无二宠物”比赛。然后我赢了！（举起第一名缎带）

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, only you could have won a pet contest with a pet rock. I should have brought Dublin. He would’ve won a contest!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，也就只有你能用宠物石头赢宠物比赛。我该带都柏林去。它一定会赢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It’s not very easy to win one of these. (shows her the blue ribbon) Does he have a costume?
dialogue.zh: 要赢这种可不容易。（给她看蓝绶带）它有服装吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They had a costume contest. You should have seen this little girl. She and her dog wore matching princess costumes!
dialogue.zh: 他们有服装比赛。你真该看看那个小女孩。她和她的狗穿了配套的公主装！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Dublin doesn’t wear costumes.
dialogue.zh: 都柏林不穿衣服。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Does he know any tricks?
dialogue.zh: 它会什么把戏吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Come this way. Now, watch this. (Dublin chases a toy)
dialogue.zh: 这边来。看好了。（都柏林去追玩具）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You caught it, Dublin! And you killed it! Good dog! Ashley, he could have won the Best Catch contest! Aw, good boy! Ashley, pets are fun, aren’t they?
dialogue.zh: 你抓住了，都柏林！还把它咬扁了！好狗！阿什莉，它本来可以赢“最佳接球”比赛！啊，好孩子！阿什莉，宠物很有趣，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Yes. And they become part of your family. (she drinks from her Dublin mug)
dialogue.zh: 对。它们会成为家人的一部分。（她用都柏林杯子喝水）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley, I think I want a dog. No. I know I want a dog!
dialogue.zh: 阿什莉，我觉得我想要一只狗。不。我确定我想要一只狗！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: It’s a big responsibility. You may want to spend time with a dog first.
dialogue.zh: 这是很大的责任。你也许该先花时间和狗待在一起。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is a great idea. But where can I find a dog?
dialogue.zh: 这主意太好了。可我上哪儿找狗呢？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: You know, Anna, I have some shopping to do. Do you want to watch Dublin for a couple of hours?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我有点东西要买。你愿意帮我看几个小时都柏林吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! I would! I will take very good care of him!
dialogue.zh: 愿意！我会好好照顾它！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I know you will. Here’s his leash.
dialogue.zh: 我知道你会的。这是它的绳子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: (to Dublin) Okay, I'll miss you!
dialogue.zh: （对都柏林）好，我会想你的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Aw. I don’t want you to be lonely. Here, Rocky can stay with you. (puts pet rock on wall)
dialogue.zh: 啊。我不想让你孤单。来，洛基可以陪你。（把宠物石头放在墙上）

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, I really don’t need … Okay. Thanks, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我其实不需要……好吧。谢谢，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure. Bye, Ashley. (to Dublin) Come on, Dublin! Bye, Rocky!
dialogue.zh: 当然。再见，阿什莉。（对都柏林）走吧，都柏林！再见，洛基！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Bye!
dialogue.zh: 再见！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna’s rock is cute, isn’t it? Oh, there is another tag question! You found some more, didn’t you? "You haven’t met my dog, have you?" Go to the VOA Learning English website to learn more.
dialogue.zh: 安娜的石头很可爱，对吧？哦，又一个反意疑问句！你又找到一些了，对吧？“You haven’t met my dog, have you?” 去美国之音英语学习网站了解更多。

quiz.prompt: Where did Anna go over the weekend?
How did Anna win a pet contest?
What does Ashley ask Anna to do?
choices: Watch Dublin for a couple of hours
